heading: Step 3: Add a controller that returns a model
body:
Yon is the server part of Tachyon. A controller is a class in `server/controllers` that answers HTTP requests. `RequestRoute("/api/greeting")` gives its path. `Public` says that anyone may call it: every route must say who may call it, or the build stops (see Who may call a route). `GetRoute` makes the method `getGreeting` answer GET requests on that path.

A model is a data type that describes the shape of a value. Here the model `Greeting` has one text field, `message`. In JavaScript, a JSDoc `@typedef` comment describes the model. In TypeScript, the model is an interface in `server/models/Greeting.ts`. The method returns a Greeting, and Yon turns it into JSON. The same `ty preview` serves the pages and the controller on one port.

Result: open /api/greeting. It shows {"message":"Hello from Yon"}.
